# Source-directory guidance

Before planning or changing source files, read [the master agent guidance](../../agents/README.md),
[the shared instructions](../../agents/instructions.md) and
[the canonical source instructions](../../agents/scopes/source.md) in full.
Follow their required skill and guideline links.

Read [Patterns and Practices](../../docs/guidelines/patterns-and-practices.md) before changing application hierarchies, lifecycle tasks or sync/async APIs. Keep this file as a pointer to those maintained guides rather than duplicating their rules.
